purpose: test whether the gate-count optimum is interior or pinned to the transmon-regime threshold, and fix the adopted design envelope

adopted_design_envelope.source: Krantz et al., Appl. Phys. Rev. 6, 021318 (2019), Sec. II A (design envelope); the 5 GHz typical-design figure is Sec. III B
adopted_design_envelope.reason: independent of the assumed noise amplitudes; reflects current engineering practice; most conservative of the three candidates

threshold_stability.note: this project's charge-dominance crossover is a RESULT, not an assumption; it moves with the noise model and is reported as corroboration only

known_limitation: the noise model contains no broadband charge sensitivity, the effect Krantz cites for requiring EJ/EC >= 50; the gate-count metric alone therefore under-penalises low EJ/EC
verdict: pinned to threshold - no interior optimum
